h1: Online Crown Casino Australia Terms: Read Them Before You Play

intro.text: These terms set the rules for your account at online Crown casino Australia. By opening an account, you accept every section below. If you disagree with any part, don't register.

content.text: We accept a player only if they meet all of the conditions below. We check each one during registration or before the first withdrawal.

items: **Age:** you are 18 or older. We confirm your age from an ID document.
**One account:** you hold one account per person, household, email address, device and payment method. We close duplicate accounts and void any winnings from them.
**Local law:** you confirm that online gambling is legal where you live. You take responsibility for checking this before you play.
**Your own funds:** you deposit only money that belongs to you and comes from a legal source.

content.text: An account at online casino Australia Crown gives you one balance for pokies, table games, live dealers, crash games and virtual sports. You manage everything from the same profile on desktop and mobile.
Opening your account

You provide your full name, date of birth, residential address, email and phone number. Enter them exactly as they appear on your ID, because we use them for verification and payouts. If your details change, update them in your profile within 30 days.
Logging in and keeping it secure

Each Crown casino Australia online login needs your email and password. Keep both private and turn on two-factor authentication in your security settings. We treat every action taken after a successful login as yours, so contact support immediately if you suspect someone else has access.
We verify every player before the first withdrawal. You can deposit and play while we check your documents, but you can't cash out until we approve them.

You can hold one active bonus at a time. While you wager a bonus, you can bet no more than A$5 per spin or hand. If you request a withdrawal before you complete the wagering, you lose the bonus and any winnings from it.
